text: This is NavisAI: an autonomous shipping documentation and trade compliance copilot, built for Averis Global Business Services. It replaces a forty five minute manual document audit with a fully automated pipeline that runs in seconds.
Operations staff can upload the shipment's real PDF paper trail here, or use these two demo buttons to instantly load a discrepant or a fully clean shipment for testing.
Let's load a discrepant palm oil export: it has an intentional container number typo and a weight mismatch buried across four different documents.

This is Stage One: Ingestion and Adaptive Audit. NavisAI's Adaptive Model Router classifies each document, sending simple ones to a fast extraction path and complex legal clauses to an extended reasoning path, then runs a full deterministic cross-document audit.
The result is immediate: a bank presentation status, an overall risk score, and a Financial Loss Exposure metric that quantifies real dollars at stake from bank fees and container demurrage.
Expanding the router assignment shows exactly which model handled which document, and the estimated sixty percent compute cost savings from not sending every document through expensive reasoning.

The System Health and AI Governance Hub gives stakeholders and engineers live observability: model runtime, a deterministic grounding score that guards against hallucination, per shipment audit cost, and the external carrier EDI gateway status.
In the Discrepancy and LC Audit tab, every single issue is tagged with the exact legal citation it violates, like U C P six hundred Article fourteen, so auditors know precisely why it matters.

This is Stage Two: Visual Redline Diff. The original submitted value is shown struck through in red, and the AI's auto-correction is highlighted in green, side by side, just like a legal document redline.
Toggling Apply and Regenerate Verified Doc instantly updates the in-memory document record with the corrected value, ready for resubmission, without ever leaving the page.

This is Stage Three: the Cross Border Statutory Gate. NavisAI checks this shipment live against U C P six hundred, MITI ATIGA Form D rules of origin, and Port of Rotterdam customs standards, flagging every failure in red.

This is Stage Four: the Navis Dispatch Engine. Each discrepancy is automatically routed to the right operational action: a carrier amendment, a trade finance alert, or a customs broker inquiry, each with a ready to send draft.
The Auto Schedule and Dispatch Pipeline queues every action with its recipient and timing. Simulate Instant Dispatch confirms live delivery with an H T T P two hundred response, right on screen.
Now the key moment: clicking Execute One Click Carrier Amendment and Re-Audit triggers a simulated instant carrier A P I fix.
Watch the entire dashboard flip live, from red to green: zero discrepancies, zero risk score, zero dollars of exposure, and cleared for bank presentation, with no page reload.
Back in the Statutory Gate, every regulatory framework now passes in real time, confirming the fix actually resolved the underlying compliance issue.
The Document Cross Comparison tab lays out every extracted field, side by side, across all four documents, so any remaining discrepancy is instantly visible at a glance.
The Export Permit and Certificate of Origin tab verifies Malaysia and Singapore customs declarations, and MITI or Chamber of Commerce authentication.
The complete audit report can be exported as JSON for enterprise archiving and bank presentation records, giving a full audit trail for compliance teams.

Finally, Ask Navis: a built in compliance copilot at the bottom of the page. Auditors can ask ad hoc questions about this exact shipment, and every answer is grounded strictly in the audit report data, never invented.
That's NavisAI: four autonomous stages, one live dashboard, turning a forty five minute manual audit and correction cycle into seconds, before a discrepancy ever becomes a penalty.
